method: Single fixed conversion factor applied to all historical monetary values
source: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates; GBP-per-EUR divided by USD-per-EUR
units: GBP equivalents at a fixed conversion rate, not historical GBP investor returns
future_stock_rule: Use the same fixed GBP-per-USD factor for stock prices, annual earnings/net income, market capitalisation, book values and any EPS/cash dividends. Keep percentage returns, earnings growth rates, dividend yields, P/E and P/B unchanged. Convert full precision before display rounding.
